Hannah / team — quick legal notes after a first pass on the Helio redlines:
- MSA: most redlines are standard commercial asks. Two items need discussion: (1) SLA uptime carveouts tied to scheduled maintenance (Helio wants 99.99 unrestricted), (2) data deletion phrasing in the DPA — Helio's template requires 30-day guaranteed deletion including backups, which is operationally tight but doable with a phased plan.
- DPA: we can accept their data deletion principle if we add a 90-day evidence window (i.e., deletion completes within 30 days, but residual backups are verifiable within 90 days). This is a common compromise.
- Order form: confirm invoicing cadence. Recommend pilot invoice as one-time credit applied to the first invoice so procurement can align budgets.

I can produce redline comments and a short memo by EOD Monday (9/28). If we want to move faster, I can join the sync Friday.
